P.name: Deathbringer Stance
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Aatrox''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|4 to 10}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|100 to 320}} against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Deathbringer Stance's'' damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

'''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|0.25*1.0*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
P.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} with a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or an {{tip|ability}}, ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of ''{{ai|The Darkin Blade|Aatrox}}''.

Q.name: The Darkin Blade
Q.description: '''Aatrox''' can activate ''The Darkin Blade'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs a strike with his greatsword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit within an area. Enemies hit within a {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of the area take {{ccs|{{#expr:(1.75-1)*100}}% '''bonus''' damage|physical}} and are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Each subsequent cast gains {{ap|0.25*100}}% more damage.
Q.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' first strike affects a 625{{times}}180-unit rectangular area in the target direction, with him centered on the back line and the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge.
Q.leveling3: {{st|First Cast Damage|{{ap|10 to 70}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 90}}% AD)}}|First Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|10*1.75 to 70*1.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.75 to 90*1.75}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' second strike affects a trapezoidal area in the target direction, with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge. The hitbox begins 100-units behind '''Aatrox''' and extends 475-units in front of him, measuring between 300 and 500-units wide from behind to in front.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' third strike affects a 300-radius circular area centered on a target location that is 200 units in front of him, with a 180-radius {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} within.
Q.description6: ''The Darkin Blade'' deals {{pp|55 to 70|key=%|1;6;11;16|formula=55% base + 5% every 5 levels thereafter}} damage against {{tip|minions}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the first cast deals {{as|25 '''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by the subsequent cast and {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} damage modifiers; and the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration from hitting the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} against them is doubled to {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Infernal Chains
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' sends a chain in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 70*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|25 to 35}}%}}
W.description2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, a {{tip|tether}} is formed between the target and the ground beneath them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to the center of the area.

E.name: Umbral Dash
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for 16% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he deals against enemy champions.
E.description3: ''Umbral Dash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Aatrox's''' basic attack timer and can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''

R.name: World Ender
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' unleashes his true form for 10 seconds, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemy {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration. He also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays by 10% of the '''current bonus''' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, lasting until ''World Ender'' has ended.
R.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}}, he extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to its original length, and becomes unleashed again.
R.description3: During ''World Ender'', '''Aatrox''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, has 5% increased [[size]], is {{tip|ghosted}}, and receives increased {{tip|heal|self-healing}} from all sources.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 40}}% AD}}}}
{{st|Increased Healing|{{ap|50 to 100}}%}}
R.description4: '''''Aatrox''' can move during World Ender's cast time.''
